WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)') AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count, 1.0 * mix_count / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM with_average
WHERE share > average_share;
